title: UIAO Link Registry Schema
description: Constrains src/uiao/canon/link-registry.yaml (UIAO_145, ADR-132 Phase 1). A Link is the governed record of one interconnection between the org and one outside party: interface + agreement artifact + regime overlay. The registry holds metadata about exchanges, never exchanged payload data, and performs no entity resolution (ADR-132 D1 boundaries).

id.description: Stable kebab-case link identifier, unique within the registry.

class.description: Counterparty taxonomy per ADR-132 D1. regulated-commercial covers regime-bound sectors (banks, hospitals, insurers); consortium covers membership bodies (AAMVA-shaped); public covers citizen/customer-facing surfaces.

direction.description: Primary data-flow direction relative to the org.

ssot-stance.description: Declared authority relationship for the exchanged data domain. A counterparty asserting authority over data the org stewards surfaces as DRIFT-SSOT-CONTENTION (ADR-074); 'contended' declares that state honestly instead of hiding it.

identity-binding.description: How the counterparty authenticates (workload-identity-federation per ADR-004 where applicable).

type.description: Agreement artifact class (ISA/MOU per CA-3, CMA per the Computer Matching and Privacy Protection Act, BAA per HIPAA, DUA for data sharing). 'unrecorded' declares honestly that no agreement artifact is registered yet — the CA-3 gap ADR-132 Phase 2 retires.

artifact-location.description: Where the agreement artifact lives today. A repo-relative path when provenance-anchored; a document-library locator string when not yet migrated.

provenance-anchored.description: True when the artifact is substrate-governed (repo-relative, hash-anchored). False marks the SharePoint-pointer state Phase 2 migrates.

review-cadence.description: Declared review cycle (CA-3 parameter PARAM-CA-003-001 is annual).

items.description: Boundary-attached regimes riding this link (e.g. hipaa, cjis, irs-1075, glba, govramp), each satisfied by a vertical adapter pack per ADR-132 D5.
Control bindings this link evidences (CA-3, CA-9, SA-9, AC-20, ...).
Repo-relative paths of the ADR(s)/spec(s) authorizing this interconnection. The substrate walker verifies these resolve (DRIFT-PROVENANCE).
